fullText.simplified:
第6章、他们当然爱我

    爸爸用手杖敲打高尔，高尔晕过去了。
    高尔在地上睡了两天。两天后的晚上，他醒了。
    腿，很疼。背，很疼。肚子，也很疼。他看了看自己的身体，还是一只大甲虫。这是怎么回事？以后我都是这个样子了吗？他难过地哭了。哭了很久以后，他想起了两天前的那个早上，马经理着急离开的样子，妈妈和妹妹害怕的样子，爸爸生气的样子，他都想起来了。
    房间外面有人在走动，但没有人说话。高尔知道，爸爸、妈妈和妹妹都在家。以前，每天晚上的这个时间，他们都在客厅里看电视。
    高尔爬到床上，他又累又饿，一点儿力气也没有了。床边的书桌上有个小熊娃娃，那是高尔离开学校的那天，最喜欢他的老师送给他的。房间里很黑，高尔躺在床上，安静地看着那个娃娃。他看了很久，后来，他觉得娃娃好像在和他说话。
    “爸爸为什么生气？”娃娃问他。
    高尔说：“他没有生气，他是害怕。”
    “不，他生气了，他用手杖打你了。”娃娃说。
    高尔不说话了，他不知道说什么，他的后背和肚子都很疼。
    “妈妈和妹妹为什么不关心你？她们不担心吗？”娃娃问。
    高尔说：“妈妈和妹妹也是害怕。”
    “你是她们的家人，她们为什么要害怕？”娃娃问。
    高尔没有回答。
    “他们爱你吗？”娃娃又问。
    高尔说：“当然，他们当然爱我！”
    天亮了，一个晚上过去了。高尔睁开眼睛，他听到了开门的声音。
    房门被人从外面推开了一点儿。高尔看不到推门的人，但地板上有一个小碟子被人从门外推了进来。碟子里有一块面包和一小杯牛奶。碟子被推进来后，门马上又被关上了。虽然很快，但高尔看清楚了，推碟子的那只手是妹妹的。
    妹妹给高尔送来了吃的东西。是的，是妹妹，那个高尔最爱的妹妹！
fullText.traditional:
第6章、他們當然愛我

    爸爸用手杖敲打高爾，高爾暈過去了。
    高爾在地上睡了兩天。兩天後的晚上，他醒了。
    腿，很疼。背，很疼。肚子，也很疼。他看了看自己的身體，還是一隻大甲蟲。這是怎麼回事？以後我都是這個樣子了嗎？他難過地哭了。哭了很久以後，他想起了兩天前的那個早上，馬經理著急離開的樣子，媽媽和妹妹害怕的樣子，爸爸生氣的樣子，他都想起來了。
    房間外面有人在走動，但沒有人說話。高爾知道，爸爸、媽媽和妹妹都在家。以前，每天晚上的這個時間，他們都在客廳裡看電視。
    高爾爬到床上，他又累又餓，一點兒力氣也沒有了。床邊的書桌上有個小熊娃娃，那是高爾離開學校的那天，最喜歡他的老師送給他的。房間裡很黑，高爾躺在床上，安靜地看著那個娃娃。他看了很久，後來，他覺得娃娃好像在和他說話。
    “爸爸為什麼生氣？”娃娃問他。
    高爾說：“他沒有生氣，他是害怕。”
    “不，他生氣了，他用手杖打你了。”娃娃說。
    高爾不說話了，他不知道說什麼，他的後背和肚子都很疼。
    “媽媽和妹妹為什麼不關心你？她們不擔心嗎？”娃娃問。
    高爾說：“媽媽和妹妹也是害怕。”
    “你是她們的家人，她們為什麼要害怕？”娃娃問。
    高爾沒有回答。
    “他們愛你嗎？”娃娃又問。
    高爾說：“當然，他們當然愛我！”
    天亮了，一個晚上過去了。高爾睜開眼睛，他聽到了開門的聲音。
    房門被人從外面推開了一點兒。高爾看不到推門的人，但地板上有一個小碟子被人從門外推了進來。碟子裡有一塊麵包和一小杯牛奶。碟子被推進來後，門馬上又被關上了。雖然很快，但高爾看清楚了，推碟子的那隻手是妹妹的。
    妹妹給高爾送來了吃的東西。是的，是妹妹，那個高爾最愛的妹妹！

sentences.english: His father hit Gao Er with a cane, and Gao Er passed out.

sentences.traditional: 高爾在地上睡了兩天。兩天後的晚上，他醒了。

sentences.english: Gao Er slept on the ground for two days. He woke up in the evening two days later.

sentences.simplified: 腿，很疼。背，很疼。肚子，也很疼。
sentences.traditional: 腿，很疼。背，很疼。肚子，也很疼。
sentences.pinyin: tuǐ hěn téng bèi hěn téng dù zi yě hěn téng
sentences.english: His legs hurt a lot. His back hurt a lot. His stomach also hurt a lot.

sentences.simplified: 他看了看自己的身体，还是一只大甲虫。
sentences.traditional: 他看了看自己的身體，還是一隻大甲蟲。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn le kàn zì jǐ de shēn tǐ hái shì yì zhī dà jiǎ chóng
sentences.english: He looked at his own body, and he was still a large beetle.

sentences.simplified: 这是怎么回事？以后我都是这个样子了吗？他难过地哭了。
sentences.traditional: 這是怎麼回事？以後我都是這個樣子了嗎？他難過地哭了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì zěn me huí shì yǐ hòu wǒ dōu shì zhè ge yàng zi le ma tā nán guò de kū le
sentences.english: What is going on? Am I going to be like this from now on? He cried sadly.

sentences.simplified: 哭了很久以后，他想起了两天前的那个早上，
sentences.traditional: 哭了很久以後，他想起了兩天前的那個早上，
sentences.pinyin: kū le hěn jiǔ yǐ hòu tā xiǎng qǐ le liǎng tiān qián de nà ge zǎo shang
sentences.english: After crying for a long time, he thought of that morning two days ago.

sentences.simplified: 马经理着急离开的样子，妈妈和妹妹害怕的样子，
sentences.traditional: 馬經理著急離開的樣子，媽媽和妹妹害怕的樣子，
sentences.pinyin: mǎ jīng lǐ zháo jí lí kāi de yàng zi mā ma hé mèi mei hài pà de yàng zi
sentences.english: The way Manager Ma left in a hurry, the scared looks on his mother and little sister’s faces, ..

sentences.simplified: 爸爸生气的样子，他都想起来了。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸生氣的樣子，他都想起來了。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba shēng qì de yàng zi tā dōu xiǎng qǐ lái le
sentences.english: .. the angry look on his father’s face—it all came back to him.

sentences.simplified: 房间外面有人在走动，但没有人说话。
sentences.traditional: 房間外面有人在走動，但沒有人說話。
sentences.pinyin: fáng jiān wài miàn yǒu rén zài zǒu dòng dàn méi yǒu rén shuō huà
sentences.english: There were people walking outside the room, but no one spoke.

sentences.simplified: 高尔知道，爸爸、妈妈和妹妹都在家。
sentences.traditional: 高爾知道，爸爸、媽媽和妹妹都在家。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr zhī dào bà ba mā ma hé mèi mei dōu zài jiā
sentences.english: Gao Er knew that his father, mother, and little sister were all at home.

sentences.simplified: 以前，每天晚上的这个时间，他们都在客厅里看电视。
sentences.traditional: 以前，每天晚上的這個時間，他們都在客廳裡看電視。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián měi tiān wǎn shang de zhè ge shí jiān tā men dōu zài kè tīng lǐ kàn diàn shì
sentences.english: In the past, at this time every evening, they would all be in the living room watching TV.

sentences.simplified: 高尔爬到床上，他又累又饿，一点儿力气也没有了。
sentences.traditional: 高爾爬到床上，他又累又餓，一點兒力氣也沒有了。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr pá dào chuáng shang tā yòu lèi yòu è yì diǎn'r lì qi yě méi yǒu le
sentences.english: Gao Er crawled onto the bed. He was tired and hungry, with no strength left at all.

sentences.simplified: 床边的书桌上有个小熊娃娃，
sentences.traditional: 床邊的書桌上有個小熊娃娃，
sentences.pinyin: chuáng biān de shū zhuō shang yǒu ge xiǎo xióng wá wá
sentences.english: There was a little teddy bear on the desk beside the bed.

sentences.simplified: 那是高尔离开学校的那天，最喜欢他的老师送给他的。
sentences.traditional: 那是高爾離開學校的那天，最喜歡他的老師送給他的。
sentences.pinyin: nà shì gāo ěr lí kāi xué xiào de nà tiān zuì xǐ huan tā de lǎo shī sòng gěi tā de
sentences.english: It was given to Gao Er by the teacher who liked him the most on the day he left school.

sentences.simplified: 房间里很黑，高尔躺在床上，安静地看着那个娃娃。
sentences.traditional: 房間裡很黑，高爾躺在床上，安靜地看著那個娃娃。
sentences.pinyin: fáng jiān lǐ hěn hēi gāo ěr tǎng zài chuáng shang ān jìng de kàn zhe nà ge wá wá
sentences.english: The room was very dark. Gao Er lay on his bed, quietly looking at the teddy bear.

sentences.simplified: 他看了很久，后来，他觉得娃娃好像在和他说话。
sentences.traditional: 他看了很久，後來，他覺得娃娃好像在和他說話。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn le hěn jiǔ hòu lái tā jué de wá wá hǎo xiàng zài hé tā shuō huà
sentences.english: He looked for a long time, and after some time, he felt like the teddy bear was talking to him.

sentences.simplified: “爸爸为什么生气？”娃娃问他。
sentences.traditional: “爸爸為什麼生氣？”娃娃問他。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba wèi shén me shēng qì wá wá wèn tā
sentences.english: “Why was your father angry?” the teddy bear asked him.

sentences.simplified: 高尔说：“他没有生气，他是害怕。”
sentences.traditional: 高爾說：“他沒有生氣，他是害怕。”
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr shuō tā méi yǒu shēng qì tā shì hài pà
sentences.english: Gao Er said, “He wasn’t angry, he was scared.”

sentences.simplified: “不，他生气了，他用手杖打你了。”娃娃说。
sentences.traditional: “不，他生氣了，他用手杖打你了。”娃娃說。
sentences.pinyin: bù tā shēng qì le tā yòng shǒu zhàng dǎ nǐ le wá wá shuō
sentences.english: “No, he was angry. He hit you with his cane,” the teddy bear said.

sentences.simplified: 高尔不说话了，他不知道说什么，他的后背和肚子都很疼。
sentences.traditional: 高爾不說話了，他不知道說什麼，他的後背和肚子都很疼。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr bù shuō huà le tā bù zhī dào shuō shén me tā de hòu bèi hé dù zi dōu hěn téng
sentences.english: Gao Er stopped talking. He didn’t know what to say. His back and stomach hurt a lot.

sentences.simplified: “妈妈和妹妹为什么不关心你？她们不担心吗？”娃娃问。
sentences.traditional: “媽媽和妹妹為什麼不關心你？她們不擔心嗎？”娃娃問。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma hé mèi mei wèi shén me bù guān xīn nǐ tā men bù dān xīn ma wá wá wèn
sentences.english: “Why don’t your mother and little sister care about you? Are they not worried?” the teddy bear asked.

sentences.simplified: 高尔说：“妈妈和妹妹也是害怕。”
sentences.traditional: 高爾說：“媽媽和妹妹也是害怕。”
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr shuō mā ma hé mèi mei yě shì hài pà
sentences.english: Gao Er said, “My mother and little sister are also scared.”

sentences.simplified: “你是她们的家人，她们为什么要害怕？”娃娃问。
sentences.traditional: “你是她們的家人，她們為什麼要害怕？”娃娃問。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ shì tā men de jiā rén tā men wèi shén me yào hài pà wá wá wèn
sentences.english: “You are their family. Why are they scared?” the teddy bear asked.

sentences.simplified: 高尔没有回答。
sentences.traditional: 高爾沒有回答。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr méi yǒu huí dá
sentences.english: Gao Er did not answer.

sentences.simplified: “他们爱你吗？”娃娃又问。
sentences.traditional: “他們愛你嗎？”娃娃又問。
sentences.pinyin: tā men ài nǐ ma wá wá yòu wèn
sentences.english: “Do they love you?” the teddy bear asked again.

sentences.simplified: 高尔说：“当然，他们当然爱我！”
sentences.traditional: 高爾說：“當然，他們當然愛我！”
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr shuō dāng rán tā men dāng rán ài wǒ
sentences.english: Gao Er said, “Of course, of course they love me!”

sentences.simplified: 天亮了，一个晚上过去了。高尔睁开眼睛，他听到了开门的声音。
sentences.traditional: 天亮了，一個晚上過去了。高爾睜開眼睛，他聽到了開門的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: tiān liàng le yí ge wǎn shang guò qù le gāo ěr zhēng kāi yǎn jing tā tīng dào le kāi mén de shēng yīn
sentences.english: The sun came up. One night had passed. Gao Er opened his eyes. He heard the sound of the door opening.

sentences.simplified: 房门被人从外面推开了一点儿。
sentences.traditional: 房門被人從外面推開了一點兒。
sentences.pinyin: fáng mén bèi rén cóng wài miàn tuī kāi le yì diǎn'r
sentences.english: The door was pushed open slightly from the outside.

sentences.simplified: 高尔看不到推门的人，
sentences.traditional: 高爾看不到推門的人，
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr kàn bú dào tuī mén de rén
sentences.english: Gao Er couldn’t see the person pushing open the door, ..

sentences.simplified: 但地板上有一个小碟子被人从门外推了进来。
sentences.traditional: 但地板上有一個小碟子被人從門外推了進來。
sentences.pinyin: dàn dì bǎn shang yǒu yí ge xiǎo dié zi bèi rén cóng mén wài tuī le jìn lái
sentences.english: .. but on the floor there was a small plate that was pushed in from outside the door.

sentences.simplified: 碟子里有一块面包和一小杯牛奶。
sentences.traditional: 碟子裡有一塊麵包和一小杯牛奶。
sentences.pinyin: dié zi lǐ yǒu yí kuài miàn bāo hé yì xiǎo bēi niú nǎi
sentences.english: On the plate there was a piece of bread and a small glass of milk.

sentences.simplified: 碟子被推进来后，门马上又被关上了。
sentences.traditional: 碟子被推進來後，門馬上又被關上了。
sentences.pinyin: dié zi bèi tuī jìn lái hòu mén mǎ shàng yòu bèi guān shàng le
sentences.english: After the plate was pushed in, the door was immediately closed again.

sentences.simplified: 虽然很快，但高尔看清楚了，推碟子的那只手是妹妹的。
sentences.traditional: 雖然很快，但高爾看清楚了，推碟子的那隻手是妹妹的。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán hěn kuài dàn gāo ěr kàn qīng chu le tuī dié zi de nà zhī shǒu shì mèi mei de
sentences.english: Although it happened quickly, Gao Er clearly saw that the hand pushing the plate was his little sister’s.

sentences.simplified: 妹妹给高尔送来了吃的东西。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹給高爾送來了吃的東西。
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei gěi gāo ěr sòng lái le chī de dōng xi
sentences.english: Gao Er’s little sister had brought him something to eat.

sentences.simplified: 是的，是妹妹，那个高尔最爱的妹妹！
sentences.traditional: 是的，是妹妹，那個高爾最愛的妹妹！
sentences.pinyin: shì de shì mèi mei nà ge gāo ěr zuì ài de mèi mei
sentences.english: Yes, it was his little sister, the little sister that Gao Er loved the most!

sentence_translations: Chapter 6: Of Course They Love Me
His father hit Gao Er with a cane, and Gao Er passed out.
Gao Er slept on the ground for two days. He woke up in the evening two days later.
His legs hurt a lot. His back hurt a lot. His stomach also hurt a lot.
He looked at his own body, and he was still a large beetle.
What is going on? Am I going to be like this from now on? He cried sadly.
After crying for a long time, he thought of that morning two days ago.
The way Manager Ma left in a hurry, the scared looks on his mother and little sister’s faces, ..
.. the angry look on his father’s face—it all came back to him.
There were people walking outside the room, but no one spoke.
Gao Er knew that his father, mother, and little sister were all at home.
In the past, at this time every evening, they would all be in the living room watching TV.
Gao Er crawled onto the bed. He was tired and hungry, with no strength left at all.
There was a little teddy bear on the desk beside the bed.
It was given to Gao Er by the teacher who liked him the most on the day he left school.
The room was very dark. Gao Er lay on his bed, quietly looking at the teddy bear.
He looked for a long time, and after some time, he felt like the teddy bear was talking to him.
“Why was your father angry?” the teddy bear asked him.
Gao Er said, “He wasn’t angry, he was scared.”
“No, he was angry. He hit you with his cane,” the teddy bear said.
Gao Er stopped talking. He didn’t know what to say. His back and stomach hurt a lot.
“Why don’t your mother and little sister care about you? Are they not worried?” the teddy bear asked.
Gao Er said, “My mother and little sister are also scared.”
“You are their family. Why are they scared?” the teddy bear asked.
Gao Er did not answer.
“Do they love you?” the teddy bear asked again.
Gao Er said, “Of course, of course they love me!”
The sun came up. One night had passed. Gao Er opened his eyes. He heard the sound of the door opening.
The door was pushed open slightly from the outside.
Gao Er couldn’t see the person pushing open the door, ..
.. but on the floor there was a small plate that was pushed in from outside the door.
On the plate there was a piece of bread and a small glass of milk.
After the plate was pushed in, the door was immediately closed again.
Although it happened quickly, Gao Er clearly saw that the hand pushing the plate was his little sister’s.
Gao Er’s little sister had brought him something to eat.
Yes, it was his little sister, the little sister that Gao Er loved the most!
